external.description:
Control what you're billed on. Tokens are the currency of AI, and how you design your app determines how many you spend. Compress conversation history instead of resending it raw, cap output tokens with matching prompt instructions, and cache static context so each reuse costs a fraction of the first request. Route each prompt to the right model by complexity, or set Model Router in Microsoft Foundry to handle that automatically — balanced, quality, or cost mode.

Then optimize the whole stack. Run Agent Optimizer to test your prompt, model, and tool configurations together and surface better setups. Use Toolbox to dynamically select only the tools each request needs and cut input token overhead by 90%. 

April Gittens, Microsoft Principal Cloud Advocate, joins Jeremy Chapman, Microsoft 365 Director, to share how to seize control of AI token spend through smarter app design.

external.description:
#AzureSQL #SQL #LearnSQL

In this episode of Data Exposed, Anthony Nocentino and Anna Hoffman walk through two MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that give GitHub Copilot real-time, controlled access to SQL Server. The agent never touches the database directly, it calls structured tools on the MCP server, which runs the queries that you control, and returns only what you've explicitly exposed. First, a custom-built server with 30 DMV-powered tools for DBA work across multiple instances. Then, Data API Builder (DAB) with zero code required for natural-language access to application data with permissions defined in config. Watch Copilot diagnose blocking, check AG health, and place a product order, all without writing a single line of SQL and all within guardrails you control.

✅ Chapters:
0:30 Intro to Anthony Nocentino
1:00 Why SQL MCP Server, for developers and DBAs
2:13 What is an MCP Server
2:58 Solution architecture
6:30 Control mechanisms
7:30 See the agent in action
8:45 SQL Server snapshot health example
14:20 Using Data API Builder as an application developer
19:00 Natural language interactions
20:30 Anthony's #1 piece of advice!

✅ Resources:
https://github.com/nocentino/sql-mcp-server and blog https://www.nocentino.com/posts/2026-05-24-giving-copilot-visibility-into-sql-server-with-mcp/

record.text:
This week's penguin: Mmmmm.... Road herrings! 
pengcognito.com/index.php?id... 
#penguins #pengcognito #cartoon #FindMy

images.alt:
Page 1: A group of penguins with fish themed drinks are sitting at a table in a restaurant. A penguin in a cowboy hat is waddling in from the left. A waiter penguin is bringing the newcomer a blue cocktail with a herring on a stick, burning with a small flame.

Cowboy hat: Apologies! I was unavoidably detained in traffic!

Waiter: Your Blue Herring-on-Fire calibrated to medium roast!

Penguin in beige hat with green fish decorations: We know!
 
Penguin in grey hat: Don't you wonder how we knew when to order your very time-specific drink?

Page 2: The penguin in the cowboy hat is now seated at the table with the herring cocktail, the flame of which is a little bigger. A penguin in a green hat is having a side conversation with a penguin in a straw hat.

Cowboy hat: Not really.

Penguin in grey hat: It's because you forgot to revoke our "stalk my friends" access after our Herring Fest trip! *ha-ha*

Penguin in green hat: I always revoke, in case it looks like I'm somewhere where I can get into trouble.

Penguin in straw hat: I work from home, I hack from home. I can get in plenty enough trouble and never move from my couch!

Page 3: The flame of the herring cocktail of the penguin in the cowboy hat is now even bigger.

Cowboy hat: I don't revoke.  It's easier than trying to text to explain that I'm stuck behind a herring truck with faulty cargo bay doors.

Green hat: That's oddly specific.

Page 4: The flame of the herring cocktail of the penguin in the cowboy hat is now even bigger, now almost threatening the hat.

Cowboy hat: Besides, I've matured. Should I and my karaoke machine be kicked out of Acoustic Folksong No Anachronisms We Mean It! Night at the pub, it wouldn't bother me at all if everybody knew!

Penguin in beige hat with green fish decorations: We do know! We were there.

Penguin in grey hat: I guess it's not as if you were taking a night school class in COBOL ...! 

Penguin in green hat:  Yeah, that would be embarrassing!

Penguin in straw hat (on phone, typing, thinking) : revoke! revoke! revoke!
